prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet chr_bloco_hurt. Output PNG 1536x1024, 512x512 pixel cells. Input image 1: mandatory gameplay STYLE reference; match cel shading, dark outline and sunset light from the left, not scenery or UI. Input image 2: BLOCO IDENTITY anchor only, ignore its opaque brown backdrop. BLOCO is a heavy demolition exoskeleton in amber and olive green, helmet with a glowing amber visor, enormous arms with hydraulic jackhammer mechanisms, black-yellow hazard stripes on the forearms, tank and pipes on the back, broad feet. Preserve exactly the armor construction, helmet, proportions and palette in image 2. No hair or scarf: translate generic hair/cloth motion to small hose and armor secondary motion; express facial emotion through visor and helmet pose, never expose a human face.
Animation: launched by a heavy hit: impact recoil with eyes shut, body folding backward, spinning tumble ×3 in the air, uncurling. One non-looping action.
Combination rules: no opponent, held object, shield bubble or stun stars. For carry_* and throw_obj keep both hand attachment positions fixed above the head across frames for compositing. For grabbed keep the collar/torso grip point fixed across cells with body suspended. Only explicitly requested attack effects are permitted: Bloco uses dust, concrete chips and amber glow, no fire or cyan electricity. Fit every pose and effect inside its own cell. Render background as actual transparent alpha; if unavailable use completely uniform #FF00FF, never brown, gradients, checkerboard or scenery. Exactly 6 poses, no extra views or details. For strong, contact is frame 5; combine anticipation phases as needed to fit eight frames. For ko only, honor the explicitly requested shrinking flight pose. Keep lateral right-facing staging even when the action involves a tumble.
Sprite sheet for a 2D side-view fighting game. Strict side view, character facing RIGHT in every
frame. Grid of 3 columns × 2 rows, 6 equal cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom as frames
1 to 6 of ONE continuous animation. The SAME character in every cell: identical proportions,
costume, colors and scale; only the pose changes, with smooth in-between motion from one frame
to the next. Feet (or lowest point when grounded) on the same baseline at 88% of the cell height;
the character's body centered horizontally in each cell; nothing crosses cell borders. Clean
cel-shaded anime illustration matching the reference image: thick dark outline (#15101C), two-tone
flat shading, crisp rim light in the character's accent color. Fully transparent background
(if transparency is impossible, flat pure magenta #FF00FF with no gradient and no shadow). No
grid lines, no frame numbers, no text, no ground, no drop shadow, no effects outside the character
unless the prompt asks for them.
